claim: Apple's admission of regulatory impact on Services growth was made orally on its July 2026 Q3 FY2026 earnings call, following which Apple reported $30.7 billion in services revenue for the June quarter -- a record but below the $31.4 billion analysts expected.
stance_target: Apple's own management commentary corroborates material regulatory impact on the contingent earnings class, independently of the disputed 'filing' quote
scope_conditions: Apple fiscal Q3 2026 (June quarter) earnings call, reported July 30, 2026
quoted_support: The figures follow Apple's admission during last month's earnings call that regulatory changes have started to weigh on its Services growth. Apple reported services revenue of $30.7 billion for the June quarter, a record for the period but short of the $31.4 billion that analysts expected.
